verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Gusto offers health insurance via a third-party partner (SimplyInsured) and that benefits deductions are collected during W2 employee onboarding and normally applied to payroll (blocked only for bonus off-cycle runs), showing enrollment and deduction sync exists. However, community reports describe concrete failures in benefits administration — botched health plan terminations causing 6+ months of billing issues, inability to customize plans across states forcing a provider switch, and platform lock-in limiting features like HSA/prorated benefits — undercutting reliability of the admin experience. Missing for 10: first-party detail on the enrollment/eligibility workflow itself, evidence of smooth cross-state plan administration, and independent confirmation that deduction sync works without support intervention.
